svg.title: From the serial port to the active page's editor
svg.text: One decoded event per step(), routed to the active page.
RX ring 256 B | TX ring 4 KB
a key, plus a repeat count
on ShellPage: InputEditor (a TextEditor) - CONTENT inserts, COMMAND moves or deletes
